GetKeypadAnchorPosition(int)

Returns an AnchorPoint mapped from a numeric keypad layout (7-8-9 on top, 1-2-3 on bottom).

Keypad layout: 7 , 8 , 9 (top row) 4 , 5 , 6 (middle row) 1 , 2 , 3 (bottom row)

7 is top-left (0,0), 3 is bottom-right (1,1). 

public static AnchorPoint GetKeypadAnchorPosition(int keypadNumber)

Parameters

keypadNumber int

The keypad number (1-9) corresponding to the anchor position.

Returns

AnchorPoint

The corresponding AnchorPoint. Returns TopLeft if the number is out of range.

GetKeypadAnchorPositionReversed(int)

Returns an AnchorPoint mapped from a numeric keypad layout (1-2-3 on top, 7-8-9 on bottom).

Keypad layout: 1 , 2 , 3 (top row) 4 , 5 , 6 (middle row) 7 , 8 , 9 (bottom row)

1 is top-left (0,0), 9 is bottom-right (1,1). 

public static AnchorPoint GetKeypadAnchorPositionReversed(int keypadNumber)
